user.title: Boat & RV Guardian
user.description: Create an integration token in the Boat & RV Guardian app, then paste it here along with the vehicle id it belongs to.

reauth_confirm.title: Token no longer works
reauth_confirm.description: The integration token was rotated or revoked. Create a new one in the app and paste it here.

error.invalid_auth: That token was rejected. Check it belongs to this vehicle, and that it has not been rotated or revoked.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Boat & RV Guardian cloud.
error.plan_excluded: This vehicle's plan does not include an integration. Integrations are available on every paid plan.
error.rate_limited: Asked too soon — this plan allows one read per its telemetry interval. Wait a moment and try again.

abort.already_configured: That vehicle is already set up.

open_valve.name: Open valve
open_valve.description: Turn the water on for a limited time. The duration is required — the valve is never opened without one.

entry_id.name: Vehicle
entry_id.description: Which configured vehicle to open. Omit when only one is set up.

duration_minutes.name: Duration
duration_minutes.description: How long the valve may stay open.
